eurostat_imm5prv.label: Immigration by age group, sex and country of previous residence
eurostat_imm5prv.methodology: Annual changes of usual residence, generally actual or intended residence of at least 12 months. Country definitions, breaks and official estimation methods can differ; inspect source metadata and flags.

flags.b|N: break in time series|not for publication
flags.bep: break in time series, estimated, provisional
flags.ip: value imputed by Eurostat or other receiving agencies, provisional

selection.ageDefinition: COMPLET preferred; REACH only when COMPLET unavailable

eurostat_imm5prv.missingPolicy: Absent/confidential/not-for-publication observations are not zero. Broad-region totals are never allocated to country pairs.
